نتخامر (form VI)
# نَتَخَامَرُ (nataḵāmaru) /na.ta.xaː.ma.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَامَرَ (taḵāmara)
# نَتَخَامَرَ (nataḵāmara) /na.ta.xaː.ma.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَامَرَ (taḵāmara)
# نَتَخَامَرْ (nataḵāmar) /na.ta.xaː.mar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَامَرَ (taḵāmara)
